title: Speaking Practice 18 - Describe a Piece of Advice You Received
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a piece of good advice someone gave you.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Piece of Advice You Received
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a piece of good advice someone gave you.

You should say: who gave you the advice, what the advice was, when they gave it to you, and explain how it helped you.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a piece of good advice someone gave you.

explanation.sampleAnswer: The best advice I received was from my father. He told me to focus on progress rather than perfection. He gave me this advice when I was stressed about university exams. It helped me stop procrastinating because I no longer feared making mistakes. Instead, I started taking small steps every day.
explanation.tips: Be specific about the advice and its impact

questions.content: Do you think young people listen to advice from older people?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Sometimes, but not always. Young people are more likely to follow advice when it comes from someone they respect and when it is delivered without judgment.

questions.content: Is it better to learn from your own mistakes or from others advice?

explanation.sampleAnswer: A combination is ideal. Some lessons are best learned firsthand, but others are too costly to learn the hard way.
